title: DecisionRequest
description: ENG-01 new contract. Source: SD authorization-and-approval.md §1,§2,§4. A specific pending decision offered to a merchant or customer, versioned by revision; a newer revision never lets an old ApprovalRecord apply to it (UNIQUE(tenant_id, decision_id, reviewed_revision) is enforced at the persistence layer in ENG-02; here the revision/hash fields that make that constraint meaningful are fixed).

revision.description: SD §4: a content change always produces a new revision and a new payload_hash; an old revision can never be approved into effect for new content.

selected_option_id.description: Only present once status is APPROVED or REJECTED.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical display payload for this exact revision (SD §3.2).

canonicalization_version.description: SD §3.2: fixes this round's canonicalization algorithm version; a future algorithm change is a new const value, not a silent reinterpretation.

target_revision.description: Expected revision of the target business object (order/service/policy) this decision is about.
